title: Annotatio II §.II: Lutherans — coexistence only; In/Cum/Sub together; Verborgen = imperceptibility; crassior not owed
pass_a_gloss: But as for formulas of speech that seem to bring in the former mode of Union, the Lutherans maintain he meant nothing other than to denote the inexplicable reason of the Coexistence of Christ’s body with the bread — and for the same cause never used one or another of the three particles In, With, and Under taken separately, but all taken together (of which nonetheless we saw the contrary in the preceding Annotation §§.3–4); and that in the rhythm he was content enough to express only the Imperceptibility of the mode of presence of Christ’s body in the Eucharist by this German word Verborgen / hidden — explaining the whole rhythm in this sense: Jesus gave us in the so small bread / His body / hidden / that is / in a hidden, incomprehensible and secret way / to eat; therefore (however violently twisted Luther’s expositions and excuses of his formulas of speech remain) we judge that that Crasser Consubstantiation cannot rightly be attributed either to Luther himself, so far as what he has said hitherto, or to today’s Lutherans.
pass_b_english: Lutherans say the crasser-sounding formulas only mark inexplicable coexistence — hence In/Cum/Sub used together, never apart (though Annotatio I §§.3–4 showed the contrary).
Verborgen in the hymn means only that the mode of presence is imperceptible — hidden, incomprehensible, secret.
However forced the excuses, Strimesius will not rightly pin that crasser Consubstantiation on Luther or today’s Lutherans.
source_text: Tùm verò formulis loquendi, priorem Unionis modum invehentibus, nil aliud sibi voluisse à Lutheranis perhibetur, quàm inexplicabilem Coëxistentiae corporis Christi cum pane rationem, denotare, eandem ob causam nunquam unâ vel alterâ ex tribus particulis, In, Cum, & Sub, separatim acceptâ, sed universis simul sumtis, usus (cujus tamen contrarium vidimus Annot. praeced. §. 3. 4.); Nec non in rythmo, solam Imperceptibilitatem modi praesentiae corporis Christi in Eucharistia, vocabulo germanico hoc, Verborgen / exprimere sat egisse, hunc in sensum rythmo integro exponendo: JEsus gab uns in dem so kleinen Brod / seinen Leib / verborgen / das ist / auf verborgene unbegreifliche und geheime Weise / zu essen; idcirco (utut expositiones ac excusationes Lutheri ejusque formularum loquendi, satis violente contortaque maneant) non tamen vel Luthero ipsi, quantum ad hactenus ab eo dicta attinet, vel Lutheranis hodiernis, Crassiorem istam Consubstantiationem rectè tribui posse arbitramur.
